comment: 35yo male with biallelic WRN germline pathogenic variants confirmed, adult-onset progeroid phenotype: lack of pubertal growth spurt + bird-like facies + premature graying with alopecia from mid-20s + bilateral cataracts diagnosed at age 28 + scleroderma-like skin changes on distal extremities + type-2 diabetes + hypogonadism + high-pitched voice. No current malignancy. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = multi-cancer surveillance bundle (annual derm full-skin exam with focus on acral lentiginous melanoma, limb MRI q1-2y for soft-tissue sarcoma + osteosarcoma, thyroid US q1y, brain MRI baseline + q2y) + concurrent endocrine/cardiometabolic comanagement + first-malignancy median age ~37y patient counseling; alternative = symptom-triggered evaluation. Validates v0.2-B rare-hereditary pilot — fires RF-WERNER-FAMILY-HISTORY-SUSPICION.
